ValidationRule.description: Closed Won deals cannot list more than 2 competitors and Negotiation deals with Hooli need a Description.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed Won'), PICKLISTCOUNT(Competitors__c) > 2), AND(ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation/Review'), INCLUDES(Competitors__c, 'Hooli'), LEN(TRIM(BLANKVALUE(Description, ''))) < 10), AND(PICKLISTCOUNT(Competitors__c) >= 4, NULLVALUE(Amount, 0) < 10000) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Competitor selections conflict with the stage.
